ip netns exec office ip route add default via 192.168.10.1 dev eth0

rndc reload
ip netns exec office dig shop.example
port: ip netns exec office nmap -p 80 shop.example
ip netns exec lb iptables -t nat -F PREROUTING
ip netns exec lb iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING -p tcp --dport 80 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.0.2.10:8080
ip netns exec office nmap -p 80 shop.example

route: ip -n office route add default via 192.168.10.1
name: dig +short shop.example
sed -i '/203.0.113.99/s/99/20/' /etc/bind/db.shop.example

port: ip netns exec lb iptables -t nat -S PREROUTING
